headline.en: Why Engineers & Developers in Kenya Use Drone Surveys
headline.sw: Kwa Nini Wahandisi & Wasanidi nchini Kenya Wanatumia Uchunguzi wa Drone

description.en: Drone surveying has become the default choice for engineering, construction and land development teams that need reliable data on tight timelines.
description.sw: Uchunguzi wa drone umekuwa chaguo la kawaida kwa timu za uhandisi, ujenzi na maendeleo ya ardhi zinazohitaji data ya kuaminika kwenye ratiba za mkazo.

description.en: Cover 200+ hectares/day with RTK drones — corridor and site surveys that used to take weeks now take days.
description.sw: Funikilia hekta 200+/siku kwa drone za RTK — uchunguzi wa njia na tovuti uliokuwa huchukua wiki sasa huchukua siku.

description.en: Reduce field time, manpower, and rework risk — one flight team replaces weeks of ground crews.
description.sw: Punguza muda wa shamba, wafanyakazi, na hatari ya kufanya upya — timu moja ya ndege inabadilisha wiki za kikosi cha ardhini.

description.en: GNSS-controlled + GCP calibrated outputs meet engineering tolerances for design and construction.
description.sw: Matokeo yaliyodhibitiwa na GNSS + kaliyabrishwa na GCP yanakidhi viwango vya uhandisi kwa usanidi na ujenzi.

description.en: CAD, DWG, LandXML, DSM/DTM, contour-ready outputs that drop straight into your design workflow.
description.sw: CAD, DWG, LandXML, DSM/DTM, matokeo tayari ya contour yanayofanya kazi moja kwa moja kwenye mtiririko wako wa usanidi.

description.en: Quarries, rivers, flood zones, large estates — mapped safely without sending crews into hazardous terrain.
description.sw: Madeni, mito, maeneo ya mafuriko, mashamba makubwa — yanaramaniwa kwa usalama bila kutuma makosi maeneo hatarini.

headline.sw: Huduma Zetu za Uchunguzi wa Angani

description.en: Accurate drone-based imagery for planning, documentation, and analysis.
description.sw: Picha sahihi za ndege zisizo na rubani kwa mipango, nyaraka, na uchambuzi.

popupContent.en: SmartGrid Surveying delivers ultra-precise aerial mapping using UAVs to generate georeferenced orthomosaics, topographic data, and planning-grade base maps. Our solutions support infrastructure, utilities, and land development with unmatched speed and accuracy.
popupContent.sw: SmartGrid Surveying hutoa uchoraji ramani sahihi wa angani kwa kutumia UAV kuzalisha orthomosaic zenye marejeleo ya kijiografia, data ya topografia, na ramani za msingi za upangaji. Suluhisho zetu zinasaidia miundombinu, huduma, na maendeleo ya ardhi kwa kasi na usahihi usio na mfano.

description.en: Track site activity using consistent, real-time aerial visuals.
description.sw: Fuatilia shughuli za kiwanja kwa kutumia picha za angani thabiti na za wakati halisi.

popupContent.en: SmartGrid offers site monitoring through high-resolution drone flyovers. Our automated flights provide weekly visual updates, detect deviations from schedule, and support decision-making for project managers and developers.
popupContent.sw: SmartGrid hutoa ufuatiliaji wa tovuti kupitia safari za ndege za risasi za mwonekano wa juu. Safari zetu za kiotomatiki hutoa masasisho ya kila wiki ya kuona, kugundua mkengeuko kutoka kwa ratiba, na kusaidia uamuzi kwa wasimamizi wa miradi na wakandarasi.

description.en: Visualize ecological change and monitor conservation areas.
description.sw: Ona mabadiliko ya ikolojia na fuatilia maeneo ya uhifadhi.

popupContent.en: Using UAVs, SmartGrid tracks land cover change, deforestation, erosion, and other ecological indicators. Our data supports impact assessments and regulatory compliance with repeatable, time-stamped visuals.
popupContent.sw: Kwa kutumia UAV, SmartGrid hufuatilia mabadiliko ya kifuniko cha ardhi, ukataji miti, mmomonyoko, na viashiria vingine vya ikolojia. Data yetu inasaidia tathmini za athari na kufuata kanuni kwa picha za muda zilizorudiwa na zilizowekwa alama.

description.en: Drone-based multispectral data for crop health and farm optimization.
description.sw: Data ya multispectral inayotokana na ndege zisizo na rubani kwa afya ya mazao na uboreshaji wa shamba.

popupContent.en: SmartGrid empowers agronomists with data on crop health, plant stress, and irrigation patterns. We use NDVI and multispectral analysis to optimize input use and improve yield sustainability.
popupContent.sw: SmartGrid huwapa agronomists data kuhusu afya ya mazao, mkazo wa mimea, na mifumo ya umwagiliaji. Tunatumia uchambuzi wa NDVI na multispectral kuboresha matumizi ya pembejeo na kuboresha uendelevu wa mavuno.

description.en: Photorealistic 3D models to support planning and inspections.
description.sw: Mifano halisi ya 3D kusaidia mipango na ukaguzi.

popupContent.en: We create detailed 3D mesh and textured models of terrain, buildings, and infrastructure. These models are BIM-ready and useful for design validation, inspection, and immersive planning.
popupContent.sw: Tunaunda mifano ya 3D ya kina ya ardhi, majengo, na miundombinu. Mifano hii iko tayari kwa BIM na ni muhimu kwa uthibitisho wa muundo, ukaguzi, na upangaji wa kina.

description.en: Route and terrain data for smart infrastructure layout.
description.sw: Data ya njia na ardhi kwa mpangilio bora wa miundombinu.

popupContent.en: We map routes and sites using drone LiDAR and photogrammetry. This ensures smart siting of roads, pipelines, and urban developments while minimizing environmental disruption.
popupContent.sw: Tunachora ramani za njia na maeneo kwa kutumia LiDAR ya ndege zisizo na rubani na photogrammetry. Hii inahakikisha uwekaji bora wa barabara, mabomba, na maendeleo ya mijini huku ikipunguza usumbufu wa mazingira.

description.en: Digital terrain and elevation models for hydrological and civil works.
description.sw: Mifano ya kidijitali ya ardhi na mwinuko kwa kazi za maji na ujenzi wa madini.

popupContent.en: Our terrain and elevation models help civil engineers and hydrologists analyze runoff, slope stability, and grading. We deliver precise elevation data to support resilient infrastructure.
popupContent.sw: Mifano yetu ya ardhi na mwinuko huwasaidia wahandisi wa madini na wataalamu wa maji kuchambua mkondo, utulivu wa pwani, na kupanga. Tunatoa data sahihi ya mwinuko kuunga mkono miundombinu imara.

description.en: Calculate material volumes and manage resources accurately.
description.sw: Kokotoa vipimo vya vifaa na udhibiti rasilimali kwa usahihi.

popupContent.en: SmartGrid computes cut/fill volumes and stockpile measurements with centimeter-level accuracy. Our aerial photogrammetry offers fast, safe, and repeatable results.
popupContent.sw: SmartGrid inakokotoa kiasi cha kuchonga/kujaza na vipimo vya matundu ya akiba kwa usahihi wa kiwango cha sentimita. Photogrammetry yetu ya angani inatoa matokeo ya haraka, salama, na yanayorudiwa.

description.en: Route and terrain data for smart infrastructure layout.
description.sw: Data ya njia na ardhi kwa mpangilio bora wa miundombinu.

popupContent.en: After floods, landslides, or earthquakes, SmartGrid uses drones to quickly document damage. Our data helps responders prioritize actions, allocate aid, and plan recovery operations.
popupContent.sw: Baada ya mafuriko, walanguku, au mitetemeko, SmartGrid inatumia drone kurekodi uharibifu kwa haraka. Data yetu huwasaidia wahudumu kupanga vipaumbele, kugawanya msaada, na kupanga urejesho.

headline.en: Eyes in the Sky, Precision on the Ground

description.en:
At SmartGrid Surveying, our aerial drone survey solutions offer high-resolution imagery, topographic mapping, and volumetric analysis with unmatched accuracy and speed. From vast farmlands to urban infrastructure, our drone technology captures data quickly, safely, and cost-effectively—especially in hard-to-reach or expansive areas. 

 We’ve completed aerial drone surveys across multiple sectors in 10+ African countries, serving land developers, governments, mining companies, and agribusinesses.
description.sw:
Katika SmartGrid Surveying, suluhisho zetu za uchunguzi wa drone wa angani hutoa picha za mwonekano wa juu, ramani za topografia, na uchambuzi wa kiasi kwa usahihi na kasi isio na mfano. Kutoka mashamba makubwa hadi miundombinu ya mijini, teknolojia yetu ya drone inakamata data kwa haraka, kwa usalama, na kwa gharama nafuu — hasa katika maeneo magumu kufikia au mapana. 

 Tumekamilisha uchunguzi wa drone wa angani katika sekta nyingi katika nchi 10+ za Afrika, tukihudumia wasanidi wa ardhi, serikali, kampuni za madini, na wamiliki wa biashara za kilimo.

headline.sw: Mtiririko Wetu wa Kazi wa Uchunguzi wa Drone

description.en: A transparent, seven-stage aerial pipeline — from the first scope call to CAD/GIS handover, you always know where your project stands.
description.sw: Mstari wa angani wa hatua saba ulio wazi — kutoka wito wa kwanza wa wigo hadi uhandishaji wa CAD/GIS, unajua wakati wowote mradi wako upo wapi.

outcome.sw: Data tayari kwa uhandisi, kwenye dawati lako

label.sw: Tathmini ya Tovuti & Ufafanuzi wa Wigo

description.en: We review your drawings or brief, define the survey area, accuracy class and deliverables, and confirm access and timing.
description.sw: Tunakagua michoro yako au maelezo ya kazi, tufafanue eneo la uchunguzi, darasa la usahihi na bidhaa, na kuthibitisha ufikiaji na muda.

description.en: Flight lines, altitudes and overlap are planned, and KCAA permissions and airspace clearance are secured before mobilisation.
description.sw: Mistari ya ndege, mwinuko na mwingiliko hupangwa, na idhini za KCAA na ufungaji wa anga hupatikana kabla ya usafiri.

description.en: GNSS-measured GCPs and checkpoints are placed across the site to calibrate the model and independently verify accuracy.
description.sw: GCP na checkpoints zilipimwa kwa GNSS htiwekwa kote tovuti kualiibrisha mfano na kuthibitisha usahihi kwa uhuru.

label.sw: Ukamataji wa Data wa UAV (RGB / LiDAR / Multispectral)

description.en: RTK-controlled UAV flights capture high-overlap imagery, LiDAR returns or multispectral bands depending on your scope.
description.sw: Ndege za RTK ziliodhibitiwa hukamata picha za mwingiliko wa juu, majibu ya LiDAR au bendi za multispectral kulingana na wigo wako.

description.en: Imagery is processed into dense point clouds, orthomosaics and elevation models on reference-controlled workflows.
description.sw: Picha huchakatwa kuwa point clouds mnene, orthomosaics na mifano ya mwinuko kwenye mtiririko uliodhibitiwa na marejeleo.

label.sw: Uthibitisho wa Usahihi wa QA/QC (Ripoti ya RMS)

description.en: Independent checkpoints are compared against the model and documented in an RMS error report for engineering sign-off.
description.sw: Checkpoints huru zinalinganishwa na mfano na kurekodiwa kwenye ripoti ya makosa ya RMS kwa saini ya uhandisi.

label.sw: Bidhaa za CAD / GIS & Uhandishaji kwa Mteja

description.en: Final DWG/DXF, LandXML, GeoTIFF and GIS packages are organised into a project folder and handed over with a walkthrough.
description.sw: Vifurushi vya mwisho vya DWG/DXF, LandXML, GeoTIFF na GIS vinapangwa kwenye folda ya mradi na kuhandishiwa pamoja na maelezo.

ctaNote.en: See exactly what your team will receive — orthomosaics, point clouds, CAD files and accuracy reports from a real project.
ctaNote.sw: Ona hasa timu yako itakachopokea — orthomosaics, point clouds, faili za CAD na ripoti za usahihi kutoka kwa mradi halisi.

description.en:
Drones have transformed the surveying industry—and we’re leading the way. Smartgrid Surveying leverages aerial drones for mapping, 3D modeling, volumetrics, environmental assessments, and monitoring large or inaccessible areas. Beyond technical mapping, we offer professional drone photography for real estate, construction marketing, tourism, and events. Using drones equipped with RTK GPS and high-resolution sensors, we capture precise geospatial data that empowers engineers, developers, governments, and NGOs to make smarter decisions, faster. 

 We deliver fast, accurate, and detailed surveys for:
description.sw:
Drone zimebadilisha sekta ya uchunguzi — na sisi tuko mbele. Smartgrid Surveying inatumia drone wa angani kwa uchoraji ramani, uundaji wa mifano ya 3D, vipimo vya kiasi, tathmini za mazingira, na ufuatiliaji wa maeneo makubwa au yasiyofikika. Mbali na uchoraji ramani wa kiufundi, tunatoa huduma za kitaalamu za upigaji picha wa angani kwa ajili ya mali isiyohamishika, uuzaji wa ujenzi, utalii, na matukio. Kwa kutumia ndege zisizo na rubani zenye RTK GPS na sensorer za mwonekano wa juu, tunakamata data ya kijiografia sahihi inayowawezesha wahandisi, wasanidi, serikali, na NGO kufanya maamuzi bora, haraka. 

 Tunatoa uchunguzi wa haraka, sahihi, na wa kina kwa:
